# under18dev

Official website repository for U18 Dev (Under18 Developers), a technology community focused on supporting developers under 18.

## Project
- Name: under18dev
- Type: React + TypeScript + Vite single-page website
- Primary language: TypeScript (TSX)

## Stack
- React 19
- React Router 7
- Tailwind CSS 4
- Framer Motion
- Vite 8

## Purpose
The site communicates U18 Dev's mission, activities, and vision with a modern, professional, developer-focused design.

## Key Files
- `src/App.tsx`: App shell, route setup, opening sequence transition
- `src/pages/HomePage.tsx`: Main landing page sections (Hero, About, Activities, Vision, Footer)
- `src/components/OpeningSequence.tsx`: Intro animation sequence
- `src/index.css`: Global styles and design tokens
- `design.md`: Design direction and brand/system guidelines

## Development
- Install dependencies: `npm ci`
- Start dev server: `npm run dev`
- Lint: `npm run lint`
- Build: `npm run build`
- Preview build: `npm run preview`
